title: Ochko123 - How the Feds Caught Russian Mega-Carder Roman Seleznev
summary: A Black Hat USA 2017 briefing by the prosecutors who caught Russian carder Roman Seleznev. It covers the electronic evidence collected, the international trail, and how he was located and arrested.
why: Pointed to as a true-crime story of cybercrime investigation, usually in passing.
